sources.claim: Admin API integrations use server-side secret keys and fixed integration permissions; documented integration endpoints include posts, pages, members, images, themes, and webhooks.
Ghost documents passwordless email-link member login and server-level protection for member/tier-gated post content.
Ghost documents an invite-only membership setting that prevents visitor sign-up while imported members can sign in.
Ghost documents webhook create, update, and delete, and states there is no independent webhook retrieval API.
Ghost documents a read-only public Content API, 15-item default pagination, and public-facing Content API keys.
